risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04q; BR-FUND-04 ⑫, BR-FUND-19 ⑤, BR-CALC-13, BR-FUND-01 R5a). Beneficiary credit execution: order_key advisory lock, re-read of order and obligation, users rows then balance rows through BeneficiaryGate, in-lock re-read of beneficiary state, ⑤ equality via planBeneficiaryCredit, CREDIT / ADJ:DEFERRED / FORFEIT / FORFEIT:DEFERRED vouchers through ledger, obligation closed only through transition() with (status, row_version) CAS in the same transaction, rebate history row for R5a. Attribution (beneficiaries, ratios, forfeited events) through commission's version-independent readCommissionAttribution (D10-317) when wired; amounts from booked_base_fen / booked_n_fen. R14 reassign and duplicate vouchers throw (most conservative).
